title: usage
description: One reading of the Claude plan's usage for the usage gate: the five-hour and weekly percentages and their resets, or why none was available. Housekeeping. Written by: usage-check.sh on every check (actor watcher); the factory loop runs it every few minutes. Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

note.description: Legacy machine-read note: the usage percentages (whole, rounded up), reset times and seconds to them, and the source; or usage=unavailable reason=<r>[,<r>...]. Read by scripts/factory-loop-replay.js (parse.ts parseUsage). Frozen until it moves into a payload (docs/events.md, Legacy notes).
note.pattern: ^(five_hour=[0-9]+ resets_at=\S+ resets_in=[0-9]+ seven_day=[0-9]+ seven_day_resets_at=\S+ seven_day_resets_in=[0-9]+ source=(oauth|statusline)|usage=unavailable reason=\S+)$
